summary: Notes that collections installed manually are not upgraded automatically when you upgrade the `ansible` package or `ansible-core`.
questions: If I install a collection by hand, will upgrading ansible-core update it too?
Why didn't my manually installed collection get upgraded with the ansible package?

answer_card.title: Manually installed collections aren't auto-upgraded
answer_card.answer_md: No. A collection you install manually (for example with `ansible-galaxy collection install`) is **not** upgraded automatically when you upgrade the `ansible` package or `ansible-core`. You need to upgrade it yourself.
